title: Counting to 5
short: Say the numbers 1 to 5 in order.
trouble: Children skip a number or say numbers out of order.

blocks.html: Let’s count to 5! Say it with me: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The numbers always come in the same order, like the steps of a little staircase.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Point to each square and say its number.

blocks.html: The counting numbers always go in the same order: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

blocks.title: Climbing steps
blocks.q: Mia climbs 5 steps. What does she say?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Count out loud together all day: stairs, socks going into the drawer, bites of a snack. Clap or stomp on each number so the words have a beat. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Count steps as you climb them.
Sing a counting song or rhyme with fingers.
